summary: An older React wrapper with no bundled types, no release since November 2024, no provenance, and a dependency tree that includes babel-runtime -> core-js 2 with a postinstall script. It also inherits lottie-web's stale JSON-only runtime. Do not adopt it.
reasoning: Last release 1.2.10 on 2024-11-30; no release in more than 12 months.
The dependency tree includes babel-runtime 6.26.0 -> core-js 2.6.12, which declares a postinstall script.
It depends on lottie-web ^5.12.2, inheriting the stale JSON renderer.
The React peer is >=15, but React 19 was only installed with --legacy-peer-deps in the audit; the wrapper is not actively tested against current React.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: babel-runtime 6.26.0 brings core-js 2.6.12, which declares postinstall: node -e "try{require('./postinstall')}catch(e){}".

evidence.detail: 3 direct dependencies including babel-runtime, lottie-web and prop-types; 41 MB installed.
